summary: Azure role assignments with a time limit apply again instead of failing.

fixes.title: Time-limited Azure roles apply again
fixes.text: Azure role assignments that a scope's PIM policy limits in duration now apply at the longest allowed duration. Before, they failed.

fixes.title: Power BI checks only when used
fixes.text: With Power BI switched off and nothing defined for it, its prerequisites are no longer checked or shown.

fixes.title: Clearer workload prerequisites
fixes.text: A prerequisite that only the portal can show now says first that Confirm or Not used closes it.

fixes.title: Sign-in clean-up
fixes.text: A new install removes a sign-in setting it no longer needs once sign-in is live.
